title: The Sadducees and the Question about the Resurrection
description: The Sadducees, who deny the resurrection, pose a hypothetical question to Jesus about a woman who, according to Mosaic law, had been married to seven brothers in succession, intending to mock belief in the resurrection. Jesus replies that they are mistaken because they know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God: in the resurrection people do not marry but are like angels in heaven. He points out that God called himself the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—he is not a God of the dead but of the living. The crowd was amazed at his teaching.
